static_preprod_genesis_crosscheck.source: captured official Preprod Shelley genesis, not a live response

genesis_provider_contract.rule: integer coercion only from documented string fields; unexpected extra fields retained in the raw step file only, not rejected and not duplicated into RESULT

tip_contract.block_no: deprecated; if present non-bool integer; tip height-field inconsistency in source is retained, not repaired

epoch_params_contract.query: exactly one explicit _epoch_no equal to step-2 epoch_no; omitted/all-history query forbidden
epoch_params_contract.max_tx_size_and_budgets: present fields must be null (explicit qualification flag) or non-bool integer >= 0; raw values only
epoch_params_contract.cost_models: type/shape recorded as unknown (null, object, or other type name) plus raw step-file reference; format unknown in all cases; cannot cost-evaluate; no invented cost decoder

address_utxos_contract.content_range_completeness: the allowlisted Content-Range is passed to validation; completeness is proven only when it exactly covers all returned rows (start 0, end total-1, row count = total), or */0 with zero rows; forms 0-2/3 partial, 0-2/*, */*, absent, malformed, or row-count-mismatched are flagged bounded/incomplete or completeness-unknown
address_utxos_contract.empty: empty with proven completeness is a provider-only unfunded report (not ledger truth); empty without proven completeness MUST be provider_reports_empty_bounded_result_completeness_unknown and never valid-unfunded
address_utxos_contract.exactly_1000_rows: bounded set only; possible truncation flag retained even if a range is present; no completeness claim beyond what the range proves

row.tx_index: non-bool integer 0..32767 (SQL smallint source bound; negative rejected)
row.value: raw non-negative decimal string; no ADA/lovelace conversion, total balance, or sum
row.asset_list_inline_datum_reference_script: retained in the raw step file only; no tx building, fee, unit, or cost inference

address_utxos_contract.no_extra_mechanism: no paging, retry, extra request, or Prefer header is added; qualified unknown is acceptable

cookies: discard_cookies=True on every get/post (indexed per-request forwarding); a Set-Cookie may still arrive in the ephemeral response object, but it is not stored in the persistent cookie jar and is not reused between calls; no claim of no Set-Cookie receipt is made
environment: source passes no explicit proxy/auth and cannot disable trust_env at the FetcherSession constructor; no-proxy/no-CA-env effect requires the root exact clean environment dict (not inherited) in EXECUTION-PROPOSAL.json with no proxy, CA-bundle, or credential entries at all; this is an operator precondition, not a code guarantee or trust theorem
partial_preservation: initial STARTED RESULT is saved, the ledger entry is saved after append before each request, transport_attempted and response_received are recorded distinctly, and Abort or any other Exception finalizes BLOCKED_PARTIAL_PRESERVED (type name only for non-Abort faults) with raw/ledger preserved on a best-effort basis; a physical write failure can prevent the final receipt, in which case the root outer captured terminal output is the authority; output is never overwritten (root passes the exact fresh O)

json_and_http.nan_infinity: reject, including literal NaN/Infinity and numeric overflow such as 1e999 via a finite parse_float check; RESULT is serialized with allow_nan=False
json_and_http.status: 200 only; non-200 body captured if within bound but never accepted
json_and_http.canonical_url: response URL must equal requested URL exactly
json_and_http.content_type: application/json only; only content-type and content-range response headers are retained
json_and_http.body_bound: <= 2097152 bytes checked before persist/JSON; Scrapling buffers whole body first, so this is not a streaming cap and there is no stream cap

receipt_bound: RESULT contains only whitelisted known-field summaries plus raw step-file references (full raw bodies remain exact separate files, so no raw observation is silently discarded); FSIZE 8 MiB is per-file, not aggregate; if even the summary exceeded the 2 MiB receipt guard, a bounded compact fallback referencing the raw files is written instead

bracket_and_funding_language.changed_tip_or_epoch: AMBIGUOUS; not an atomic or authenticated snapshot; no silent retry
forbidden_claims: complete UTxO set at exactly 1000 rows
complete UTxO set from an incomplete, unknown-total, malformed, or absent Content-Range
code alone guarantees no proxy or CA environment effect
